description:
Adds an optional **Reddit - Vertical home feed** patch for Reddit 2026.14.0.

A **Vertical feed** button appears on Home. It opens Reddit's post viewer with vertical swipes using the posts already rendered in Home, in their current order. The viewer stops at the end of the loaded set; scroll Home first to load more posts. Normal post taps keep their existing behavior.

This patch is experimental and needs device testing. The existing Hide app posts and NSFW mode patches are unchanged. Select the built-in Morphe source alongside this source, as before.
